clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau asked a Harvard-trained cardiologist to run a full heart scan, just to check, with no symptoms at all.

The results: circulation like an 18-year-old, near-zero calcification in the arteries, a resting heart rate like an athlete, perfect blood pressure.

The doctor's response: he was still going to recommend the cholesterol-lowering drug anyway, because one blood number read 225.

His reason, word for word: he's putting the recommendation in his own notes, because he has to.

What would you ask before filling that prescription?

#kevintrudeau #cholesterol #hearthealth #healthtruth #wbdaily #askquestions
